
  ╭─────────────────────────────────────────────╮
  │  /copy  (/cp)                               │
  │  Copy to Clipboard                          │
  ╰─────────────────────────────────────────────╯

  Summary:
    Copy the last response, code block, or written file.

  Usage:
    /copy
    /copy code
    /copy file

  Details:
    Copies content to the system clipboard:
      • /copy       — the last full response
      • /copy code  — the last fenced code block in the response
      • /copy file  — the content of the last written file

  Examples:
    $ /copy code

  Related: /show  /export
